verdict.rationale: Activepieces has a publish/staged-changes flow with sensitive-flow review gating (docs-11, docs-22, docs-23), which offers some environment-promotion-like governance, but there is no evidence of git-based version control, diffing, branching, or explicit dev-to-production environment promotion across separate deployments. missing for 10: git/source-control integration for workflows, multi-environment (dev/staging/prod) promotion mechanism, version history/rollback, independent confirmation of the publish-review workflow in practice.
